# Triton attribution

The grouped GEMM in `kernels/fp16_native_kernel.py` derives from Triton's MIT-licensed matrix multiplication tutorial:

https://github.com/triton-lang/triton/blob/main/python/tutorials/03-matrix-multiplication.py

The original tutorial file used during development had SHA-256:

`bee6279533312380ffa64042d3c460d0617d48c1ef49cc3afe0e4542c059bab7`

The corresponding MIT license is preserved in this directory, in the repository's `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt`, and in the embedded header / application About dialog.
